name: a live counter spins up to a round milestone
looks: A small live label sits above a big number whose digits spin like an odometer, some settling while others keep rolling, climbing fast across several hard cuts until it lands exactly on a clean round number. A thin rising line with a soft glow draws in behind it, and a short line of support text settles underneath once it stops.
build: Each digit is its own column tweening through values on a loop until it locks on its target frame, independent per digit so some settle before others; the line chart draws with strokeDashoffset on power3.out behind the number; the support text fades/rises in once the last digit locks.
sound: A fast mechanical whir under the spinning digits, slowing and landing on a solid confirm tone when it locks.
prompt: Spin a big number's digits like an odometer, independently settling one at a time, climbing fast across hard cuts until it lands exactly on a clean round milestone, with a thin glowing line rising behind it and a short support line settling underneath once it locks.
